flow_graph.procedure_name: EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
flow_graph.description: The EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure enables mutual authentication of the UE and the network using EAP-AKA', EAP-TLS, or other EAP methods, and establishes key material for secure communication.

properties.description: UE initiates the registration procedure, triggering the authentication process.
AUSF or AAA server sends an EAP-request/AKA'-challenge, EAP-Request/Identity or EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity message to the UE.
UE checks USIM presence, SNN, and handles the EAP-request message as specified in IETF RFC 5448.

UE sends an EAP-response message (e.g., EAP-response/AKA'-challenge, EAP-response/AKA'-authentication-reject, EAP-response/AKA'-synchronization-failure, or EAP-response/AKA'-client-error) to the network.
AUSF or AAA server processes the EAP-response message. If successful, generates EMSK/MSK, KAUSF, and KSEAF.
AUSF or AAA server sends an EAP-success or EAP-failure message to the UE.
UE processes EAP-success: deletes old keys, generates new keys (KAUSF, KSEAF, KAMF), creates a partial native 5G NAS security context and resets counters. Considers procedure complete.
UE processes EAP-failure: deletes partial native 5G NAS security context, new KAUSF, new KSEAF, and considers the procedure complete.
The AUSF or the AAA server of the CH or the DCS decides to initiate the EAP based identification procedure.
The UE sends an AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message with EAP-Response/Identity or EAP-Response/AKA'-Identity to the network.
UE initiates registration, triggering the authentication procedure.
UE initiates registration, triggering the authentication procedure which leads to eap based identification.
AUSF/AAA server triggers eap identification, so send an EAP-Request/Identity/AKA'-Identity
